snippet.title: Feather's Edge - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Feather’s Edge demo is live: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5094710/Feathers_Edge_Demo/ 

Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

For more information, visit: https://feathers-edge.com 
Wishlist Feather’s Edge today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804760/Feathers_Edge/


Credits:

Simeon Willemse: Art Direction & Illustration
Daoyi Liu: Animation
Austin: Animation
Max Nattrass: Music & Sound Effects
Bracken Hall: Capture & Editing
Leon van Niekerk: Production & Coordination
Francois van Niekerk: Vision
